question: does E57's joint rule-out of the never-surfaced files survive measured reading-to-reading dependence?
model: random-effects: each reading's rate is a draw from the empirical distribution; P(all zero) = E_w[(1-p*w)^n]^k, convex in w so correlation raises it — the check CAN fail, unlike the conditional version it replaces (which Jensen made vacuous, §17)
verdict: BOUND HOLDS UNDER THE CORRECTED MODEL — the random-effects correlation shifts the threshold by less than 15%, so E57's ~3% rule-out stands
limit: models only the reading-level channel; residual dependence would weaken further
